title: atlax element (atlax/elements/<designation>.yaml)
description: One element of an artifact's atlax slice, one file per element (ruled 2026-10-31), named by its designation with ':' written '.'. Holds only what is written on purpose; what exists in code is derived by `atlax publish` and is not here. Norm: Atlas (docs/atlas/manifesto.md), maturity binary (`authored`) plus `lifecycle`. Writers: the artifact's FSE, Daedalus and builders, through a card's change order. Readers: `atlax verify`, `atlax publish`, `atlax check` (claudecode bin/atlax), the Deltagos map lens, Elenx C4, Daedalus. Samples: element.sample.yaml, element-consumer.sample.yaml, element-wails.sample.yaml, element-cli.sample.yaml, published/agent-mailbox-api/elements/*.yaml.

designation.description: The one stable tag (proposition 4), written form only: `fn:` `prod:` `loc:` or `evt.` `data.` `rule.`. Never reused; a retired element keeps it.

product.description: The product aspect when the designation is a function: the artifact part that realizes it (builds on the c4-map locked ids).

location.description: Where it runs. Written by Talos on a deploy commit (Operation).

kind.description: http: a route the artifact serves; wails: a Go method bound to a desktop frontend by Wails (`Bind:` in wails.Run's options); cli: a command; outbound: a call it makes to another artifact; event: one it emits; data: an entity it keeps; rule: a decision table (rows).

summary.description: One line: what it does for whom.

authored.description: true: a promise, part of the membrane; changes only through a change order that lists it, and a drift is a redline. false: organic; never a finding. Only a human promotes (or a decision record rules it born authored).

lifecycle.description: Independent of authored. An element born authored from a decision record enters planned and goes live when its tests pass.

owner.description: The seat that answers for it (an FSE, or Hephaistos for the factory's own).

ruled_by.description: The decision record that made it authored, when one did.

terminal.description: How to find it in code. http and outbound: method and path (Go 1.22 mux pattern; verify's shadow check compares them). wails: binding (Struct.Method) and signature (types only, as atlax derives it: a changed one is a redline when authored). cli: command (the words after the binary). event: topic. data: store and entity.

binding.description: wails: the bound struct and its exported method.

signature.description: wails: the parameter and result types, gofmt spelling, no names: "(string, int) ([]model.Ticket, error)".

contract.description: The shared contract sample that states the promise (specs/contracts/README.md).

repo.description: The repo holding the sample, by its directory under the initiative root (specs).

path.description: The sample's path inside that repo.

test.description: The test that proves the element; `atlax verify` runs it.

characteristic.description: The rule element that holds this element's decision table, when it has one.

rows.description: kind rule only: the decision table. Every row names its test and has its own lifecycle (a live row's test failing is a redline; a planned row is reported, never blocks).

when.description: The input and state the row matches.

consumes.description: Promises this element reads from other artifacts. `atlax verify` checks them against the local atlax clone (ATLAX_DIR); `atlax check` notifies this element's owner when one changes.

ext.description: ext:<artifact>#<designation>, the artifact by its id (repo slug).

path.description: The test file, relative to the artifact repo's root.

name.description: The test as its runner names it (Go: TestX or TestX/sub_test).
